### Fixes

- Keep collapsed Profile, Settings, and Exit controls out of D-pad focus traversal.
- Restore focus to the previously selected title after returning from Details in Search and My Library, with a first-title fallback.

### Validation

- Added regression coverage for hidden navigation focus targets and Details-return focus in Home, Search, and My Library.
- The release workflow runs JVM/coverage checks, instrumentation-test compilation, lint, and a signed 32-bit APK build. Device/emulator tests remain excluded from tag releases.
